scene mikuvac1
Makoto and I split apart as soon as we get back to the beach.
lines.zh: 我和Makoto一回到海滩就分开了。

lines.en: She said something about wanting to go get lunch but, not being particularly hungry myself, I elect to put on my swim trunks and walk around instead of tagging along with her.
lines.zh: 她说了些想去吃午饭的话，不过我自己不太饿，于是决定换上泳裤四处走走，不跟她一起去。

lines.en: : Hey! You there! With the legs!
lines.zh: : 嘿！那边那个！长着腿的！

lines.en: Being a person with legs, I instinctively respond and turn around to see Miku waving me over to the water.
lines.zh: 作为一长腿的人，我下意识地回头，看到Miku在水里朝我招手。

lines.en: She’s alone at the moment, so I imagine she needs someone to talk to or all of that energy welling up within her will cause her to explode and destroy Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 这会儿她是一个人，所以我想她大概需要找人说说话，不然她体内那股涌动的能量会让她爆炸，把 Kumon-mi 夷为平地。

lines.en: I live in Kumon-mi, so it would be bad if I were to sit back and let it explode.
lines.zh: 我住在 Kumon-mi，所以坐视它爆炸可不太好。

lines.en: I must do my duty to defend the city.
lines.zh: 我必须尽到保卫这座城市的义务。

lines.en: scene mikuvac2
: Ahoy there matey!
lines.zh: : 啊嘿，船长！

lines.en: : Yo.

: Whatcha doin’? You and Makoto have fun doin’ cabin stuff?
lines.zh: : 你干啥呢？你和Makoto在小屋里玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Sure. She had a little more fun than I did, though.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过她比我玩得开心多了。

lines.en: : Makes sense. She’s always talkin’ about how cool and handsome and smart ya are.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。她老说你又酷又帅又聪明。

lines.en: That’s not really what I meant, but I’ll allow Miku to think whatever she wants since telling her I just fingered her best friend might scare her off.
lines.zh: 我其实不是这个意思，不过就随Miku怎么想吧，毕竟告诉她我刚刚用手指把她最好的朋友弄了，可能会把她吓跑。

lines.en: : What about you, Miku? What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Miku？你在干什么？

lines.en: : And why are you all alone in the water?
lines.zh: : 还有你为什么一个人在水里？

lines.en: : Cause I like water! Duh.
lines.zh: : 因为我喜欢水啊！废话。

lines.en: : Plus, there's nothin’ wrong with a little alone time every now and then.
lines.zh: : 再说偶尔一个人待会儿也没什么不好。

lines.en: : I was playin’ with Ami and Ayane before but they went to get lunch and now I’m all like “Gahhhh woe is me” and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我刚才还在和Ami、Ayane玩，结果她们去吃午饭了，现在我就跟「啊——我好可怜」似的。

lines.en: : Are you not hungry?
lines.zh: : 你不饿吗？

lines.en: scene mikuvac4
: Nah. I had a huge breakfast this morning and if I eat more than 1300 calories in a day I’ll get fat and undesirable.
lines.zh: : 不饿。我早上吃了顿丰盛的，而且一天摄入超过一千三百大卡我就会变胖、变得没人要。

lines.en: scene mikuvac5
: It’s hard enough gettin’ people to look at me as a girl to begin with.
lines.zh: : 光是让人把我当女生看就已经够难的了。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta keep up this tomboy thing as long as I can or I’ll just fade into the abyss.
lines.zh: : 我得把这个假小子的形象一直维持下去，不然就会被丢进深渊里彻底消失。

lines.en: : Hey, the tomboy thing works for you at least.
lines.zh: : 嘿，至少假小子这套对你挺管用的。

lines.en: scene mikuvac6
: Not as good as it works for Karin. Know any tips for your pal Miku to grow some big ole' melons like her?

: Does that actually work?!

lines.zh: : 不知道。不过不管有没有用我都不介意。

lines.en: : Is that even legal?!

lines.en: : You know, cause we’re like student and teacher.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，毕竟我们是学生和老师的关系。

lines.en: : Right. Yeah I don’t think there are any specific laws against teachers...massaging their students' breasts.
lines.zh: : 对。嗯，我觉得应该没有哪条法律专门禁止老师……给学生按摩胸部。

lines.zh: : 只是有点……不被人待见罢了。

lines.en: scene mikuvac4
It doesn’t hit me how ridiculous that notion is until I get it out of me.
lines.zh: 等我把话说出口，才意识到这个想法有多荒唐。

lines.en: Miku doesn’t seem to mind, though.
lines.zh: 不过Miku似乎并不介意。

lines.en: If anything, she actually looks like she’s thinking about it.
lines.zh: 要说的话，她看起来反而真的在认真考虑。

lines.en: : Hmm...Idunno. Doesn’t that sound a little sketchy to you?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不知道。你不觉得这听起来有点可疑吗？

lines.en: : Obviously I don’t know much about girl-on-guy contact and stuff, but I’m pretty sure that sorta thing is saved for boyfriends and girlfriends.
lines.zh: : 我当然不太懂女生和男生之间的接触什么的，不过我敢肯定那种事是留给男女朋友做的。

: Wait! Is this a confession?!

lines.en: : There are several girls I can think of off the top of my head that would kill me if I came anywhere close to doing something like that.
lines.zh: : 我随随便便就能想到好几个女生，我要是敢那么做，她们会杀了我的。

lines.en: scene mikuvac9
: Phew. That’s a relief.

lines.zh: : 我刚才开始有种从没体验过的感觉了。

lines.en: : Kinda like when you finish ‘yer french fries but, oh look! There are more in the bag!
lines.zh: : 有点像你吃完薯条，结果哦哟！袋子里还有！

: Know what I’m talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 懂我意思吧？

lines.zh: 这是我听过最奇怪的形容「性奋」的方式，不过我大概明白Miku想说什么。

lines.en: Extra french fries are always a magical feeling.

lines.en: What the fuck am I even talking about?

lines.en: : I’m not banned from thighs, though, am I? That was one of the key reasons I decided to coach your team.
lines.zh: : 不过大腿应该没被禁吧？那可是我当初决定当你们队教练的主要原因之一。

: You didn’t decide anything. I had to force ya to join because you were takin’ too heckin’ long to agree.
lines.zh: : 你才没决定呢。是我逼你加入的，因为你磨磨蹭蹭半天不同意。

lines.zh: : 你要是愿意，我现在就很乐意给你按按腿。

lines.en: : Okay. I’ll just wait until you’re {i}ready{/i} to get to the massaging.

lines.zh: 看到她们两个穿泳衣，和看到同行这趟旅行另外十二个女生一样，令人愉快。

lines.en: : Hey, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗨，Sensei……

lines.zh: : 哇！我都没看到你们俩走过来！

lines.en: : I thought you couldn’t make it?
lines.zh: : 我还以为你们来不了呢？

lines.zh: : 你知道她们要来？

lines.en: : Heh? You listenin’ to me? I literally just said I thought they couldn’t make it.
lines.zh: : 哈？你在听我说话吗？我刚刚才说我还以为她们来不了。

lines.en: : Yeah but that implies that you knew they were planning on coming.
lines.zh: : 是，可这话的意思是你本来就知道她们打算来。

lines.en: : Well yeah, I invited them. The more the merrier and all that.
lines.zh: : 那当然，是我邀请的。人多热闹嘛。

lines.en: : We barely have enough room for everyone as-is.
lines.zh: : 我们现在本来就快住不下了。

lines.en: scene mikuvac16
: Should we not have come?...
lines.zh: : 那我们是不是不该来？……

lines.en: : I had a feeling Miku wasn’t being entirely honest when she said she talked it over with everyone, but I thought that at least {i}you{/i} knew about it.
lines.zh: : 我就觉得Miku说已经跟大家都商量过这事有点不太老实，不过我以为至少{i}你{/i}是知道的。

: Oh, whoops! Did I say for {i}you{/i}?

lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！我是说来海滩看的。我真是的。

lines.en: : I mean, we do have an extra room if you can't fit in the first one, so I guess it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果你们挤不进第一间，我们确实还有一间多余的房间，所以应该没问题。

lines.en: : I just feel kind of bad for Ayane and Makoto since neither of them knew about this.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得对Ayane和Makoto有点过意不去，因为她们俩都不知道这事。

lines.en: scene mikuvac18
: Ayane knows. I texted her on the way here.
lines.zh: : Ayane知道。我来这儿的路上给她发过短信。

lines.en: : And she said she’s okay with it?
lines.zh: : 她说可以了？

lines.zh: : 嗯。她甚至说如果我们要的话，可以出钱给我们单独开一间房。

lines.zh: Ayane到底有多少闲钱啊？……

lines.en: scene mikuvac19

lines.zh: : 麻烦？你把我们当成什么人了？

lines.zh: : 我们会乖乖的。我们不想给你们添麻烦。

lines.zh: : 而且你要是需要帮忙准备晚饭什么的，尽管交给我。

lines.en: : AH! MY EYES!
lines.zh: : 啊！我的眼睛！

lines.en: Kirin begins to pull my hand downward and sparks an immediate reaction from Miku.
lines.zh: Kirin开始把我的手往下拉，Miku立刻就有了反应。

lines.en: But before I can pull away, the ace of the soccer team springs into action and leaps out of the water, running over to me and pushing Kirin to the ground.
lines.zh: 可我还没来得及抽手，足球队的王牌就弹了起来，蹿出水面朝我跑来，一把把Kirin推倒在地。

lines.en: scene black
: OKAY! THAT’S ENOUGH!
lines.zh: : 好啦！够了啊！

lines.en: : It’s my turn to get all touchy-feely with Sensei before anything Rated-M happens!
lines.zh: : 在发生什么限制级的事之前，该轮到我和Sensei亲热亲热了！

lines.en: : Miku! What the fuck?! Did you really just push me over?!
lines.zh: : Miku！你他妈搞什么？！你真把我推倒了？！

lines.en: Miku hugs me from behind and pulls her body against mine, bringing one of her hands to my abdomen.
lines.zh: Miku从背后抱住我，把身体贴上来，一只手搭在我的腹肌上。

lines.en: scene mikuvac27
: Holy guacamole! You’re outright chiseled!
lines.zh: : 我的天！你这简直是雕刻出来的！

lines.en: : Why the heck were you keepin’ these things hidden for so long?!
lines.zh: : 你干嘛把这些东西藏这么久啊？！

lines.en: : If I had abs like this I’d be friggin’ crackin’ eggs on ‘em or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 我要有这么漂亮的腹肌，早就他妈在上面敲鸡蛋了什么的。

lines.en: : Weird compliment but I’ll accept it.
lines.zh: : 这夸奖挺怪的，不过我收下了。

lines.en: Miku’s hand trails back and forth across my body, poking and pressing nearly everywhere she can reach.
lines.zh: Miku的手在我身上来回游走，几乎把她够得到的地方都戳了个遍按了个遍。

lines.en: It isn’t long before Kirin gets jealous again and also hops on the bandwagon...
lines.zh: 没过多久，Kirin又吃醋了，也跟着加入了……

lines.en: scene mikuvac28
: Holy shit, you’re right.
lines.zh: : 我操，你说得对。

lines.en: : It feels like I have my hand on a rock right now.
lines.zh: : 感觉我像是把手放在了石头上。

lines.en: Kirin follows suit and also allows her hormones to take control of her mind.
lines.zh: Kirin有样学样，也让荷尔蒙掌控了自己的大脑。

lines.en: Both of their hands wander all over, Kirin’s often poking into my waistband, while Miku drags hers upward.
lines.zh: 她们两个的手到处乱摸，Kirin的手经常往我裤腰里戳，Miku则往上拽。

lines.en: : I think...I could do this all day.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我能这么摸上一整天。

lines.en: : Same. I want my own Sensei to take home and play with.
lines.zh: : 我也是。我想要一个属于自己的Sensei带回家玩。

lines.en: : There is only one of me and something unforgivable is bound to happen if the two of you keep touching me like this.
lines.zh: : 我只有一个，要是你们俩再这么摸下去，肯定会出什么不可饶恕的事。

lines.en: scene mikuvac29
: Hm? What do ya mean ‘unforgivable’? Do ya not like bein’ touched or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 哈？「不可饶恕」是什么意思？你不喜欢被摸还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Yeah, tell us Sensei~ What will happen if the two of us keep touching you like this?
lines.zh: : 是啊，告诉我们嘛，Sensei~要是我们俩继续这么摸你会怎样？

lines.en: : Karin, why are you just letting this happen?
lines.zh: : 花梨，你就这么看着不管吗？

lines.en: : C-C-C-C-C-C-C-
lines.zh: : 结……结结结结结结——

lines.en: : Oh, right. She’s broken.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。她死机了。

lines.en: scene black
I’m able to last another ten seconds or so before I need to pull the plug and back away from the two of them.
lines.zh: 我又撑了大概十秒钟，就不得不紧急叫停，从她们俩身边退开。

lines.en: : Hey! Where do you think you’re goin’?
lines.zh: : 嘿！你以为你要去哪儿？

lines.en: : We’re not done with you yet!
lines.zh: : 我们还没完呢！

lines.en: : Sensei! Come back! I wanna feel how hard it is!
lines.zh: : Sensei！回来！我想摸摸它有多硬！

lines.en: Kirin’s words are obviously packed with a double-meaning.
lines.zh: Kirin的话显然是话里有话。

lines.en: Miku, I can forgive for not fully understanding what's going on, but Kirin-
lines.zh: Miku不理解状况，我可以原谅，可Kirin——

lines.en: She knows what she’s doing.
lines.zh: 她很清楚自己在干什么。

lines.en: It’s intimidating.
lines.zh: 挺吓人的。

lines.en: I retreat to behind the restroom and press my back against the wall, waiting for a certain part of my body to calm down before I reveal myself again.
lines.zh: 我撤退到洗手间后面，背靠墙壁等身体某个部位冷静下来，再出去见人。
